## MixRoom — Unified Planner Jev-ai
Jev recognizes five complete simple requests; code builds the plan.
GPT-5.4 plans all other requests, with the original context intact.
One canonical validator; Flutter executes and verifies.

Chat: /mixroom-jev-plan
Mix compatibility: /mixroom-jev-mix-resolve

## Context and configuration
All model settings, Jev thresholds and limits live in **Configure Planner**.
No snapshot truncation. Pending plan modifications go directly to GPT.
One shared 110-second deadline, up to one Jev and two GPT calls.

## 2 · Optional detail lookup
One batch, at most four lookups. Snapshot data only.
The same planner then returns a final plan.
Shared 110-second deadline; no retries or repair loop.

## 3 · Validate and respond
Canonical schema + supported commands + target types + ordered references + budgets.
Invalid output returns an HTTP error with no executable plan.
Trace is contract-only; timing and usage are response headers.
Mutation success belongs to Flutter receipts.

## Mix compatibility
Returns the incoming actions unchanged. No model call.
Learned mixing refinement is outside this workflow.
Both webhooks use the stored MixRoom R&D Webhook credential.

## Maintenance and evaluation
Credentials: TypeSafe Jev — MixRoom R&D; OpenAI account; MixRoom R&D Webhook.
No key values in this export. Single workflow; no helper service or child workflow.
Routing and separate provider usage are saved in execution metrics and HTTP headers; app response contract is unchanged.
Jev budget: 3 seconds, no retry; overflow bypasses Jev without trimming the original request.
Research: docs.typesafe.ai/api · /confidence · /model-jaggedness/jev-1.13 · /cookbooks/function_calling

## Jev: small complete requests only
Pinned jev-1.13.0. Play, pause, metronome on/off, current BPM.
Choice + independent whole-request coverage + English/standalone checks.
No partial compound plans, guessed targets, numbers or MIDI generation.
Uncertainty, provider error, timeout or excess routing context → full GPT planner.
Thresholds are experimental, not a guarantee of correctness.
